title: Pan-Seared Duck in Indian Spice Crust
description: A flavorful and aromatic duck dish with a crunchy German-inspired spice crust, served with toasted bread. This Indian-inspired recipe combines the bold flavors of cumin and coriander with the richness of duck.
instructions: Season the duck breast with salt and black pepper.
Mix together cumin, coriander, garam masala, and salt for the spice crust.
Coat the duck breast with the spice crust mixture, pressing gently to adhere.
Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the duck breast until browned, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast the duck for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked to your liking.
Meanwhile, toast the German bread and slice into 1-inch pieces.
If using bitter gourd, slice into thin rounds and set aside.
To serve, slice the roasted duck breast and serve with toasted bread, bitter gourd (if using), and a sprinkle of crunchy rice flakes.
